	PROCEDURE cargargrilla
		Local vGrabacion,nCantidadCotizaciones
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		ThisForm.Tg_PageFrame1.Page1.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page1.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oTblAux_Valores.Alias
		
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page1.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Valores.Alias+".id_Valor"
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page1.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Valores.Alias+".nombre"
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page1.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Valores.Alias+".seleccionado"
		
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.tg_grid2.RecordSourceType=1
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.tg_grid2.RecordSource=thisform.oTblAux_cajas.Alias
		
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.tg_grid2.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_cajas.Alias+".id_caja"
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.tg_grid2.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_cajas.Alias+".nombre"
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.tg_grid2.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_cajas.Alias+".seleccionado"
		
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.Alias
		
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.Alias+".id_moneda"
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.Alias+".nombre"
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.Alias+".seleccionado"
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.Alias+".rango"
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.Alias+".backcolor"
		
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.tg_grid1.Column4.DynamicBackColor = "thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.Leer('backcolor')"
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.tg_grid1.Column4.DynamicForeColor = "thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.Leer('backcolor')"
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Valores.IrPrimero()
		thisform.oTblAux_cajas.IrPrimero()
		thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page1.Tg_Grid1.Refresh()
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.Tg_Grid2.Refresh()
		thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.fijarTag("CLAVE")
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.Tg_Grid1.Refresh()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargarmonedas
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		** Cargo la tabla auxiliar con las distintas monedas
		thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.EsEof()
			If thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.Leer("id_moneda")=ThisForm.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value or ThisForm.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value="TD"
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_moneda",thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.Leer("id_moneda"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"nombre",thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.Leer("nombre"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.t.)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"rango",0)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"foreColor",16777215)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"backColor",16777215)
				thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
			EndIf
			thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.IrPrimero()
		
		
		** MODIFICO LA GRILLA CAMBIANDO LOS VALORES O AGREGANDO NUEVOS SEGUN CORRESPONDA.
		thisform.oTblMonedas.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblMonedas.EsEof()
			If thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.buscar(thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("id_moneda")+str(thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("rango")),.f.,"CLAVE")
				** encontre id y rango, modifico con lo qe corresponde
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.t.)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"rango",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("rango"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"backColor",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("backColor"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"foreColor",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("foreColor"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_moneda",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("id_moneda"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"nombre",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("nombre"))
				thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
			Else
				** encontre id pero no rango, agrego nuevo registro
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.t.)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"rango",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("rango"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"backColor",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("backColor"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"foreColor",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("foreColor"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_moneda",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("id_moneda"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"nombre",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("nombre"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_moneda",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("id_moneda"))
				thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
			EndIf
			thisform.oTblMonedas.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblMonedas.IrPrimero()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargartablas
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		** VALORES
		thisform.oTblCaj_Valores.IrPrimero()
		Do While !thisform.oTblCaj_Valores.EsEof()
			If thisform.oTblCaj_Valores.Leer("id_tipo")="EF"
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Valor",thisform.oTblCaj_Valores.Leer("id_valor"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"nombre",thisform.oTblCaj_Valores.Leer("nombre"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.f.)
				thisform.oTblAux_Valores.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
			EndIf
			thisform.oTblCaj_Valores.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblCaj_Valores.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.oTblValores.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblValores.EsEof()
			thisform.oTblAux_Valores.buscar(thisform.oTblValores.leer("id_valor"),.f.,"CLAVE")
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.t.)
			thisform.oTblAux_Valores.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
			thisform.oTblValores.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblValores.IrPrimero()
		
		
		** CAJAS
		thisform.oTblCaj_Cajas.IrPrimero()
		Do While !thisform.oTblCaj_Cajas.EsEof()
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Caja",thisform.oTblCaj_Cajas.Leer("id_Caja"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"nombre",thisform.oTblCaj_Cajas.Leer("nombre"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.f.)
			thisform.oTblAux_Cajas.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
			thisform.oTblCaj_Cajas.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblCaj_Cajas.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.oTblCajas.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblCajas.EsEof()
			thisform.oTblAux_Cajas.buscar(thisform.oTblCajas.leer("id_Caja"),.f.,"CLAVE")
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.t.)
			thisform.oTblAux_Cajas.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
			thisform.oTblCajas.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblCajas.IrPrimero()
		
		
		thisform.cargarMonedas()
		
		
		** RANGOS
		*!*	thisform.oTblIndicadores.IrPrimero()
		*!*	thisform.oTblIndicadores.buscar("CHE",.f.,"CLAVE")
		*!*	thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.txtRojo.value=str(thisform.oTblIndicadores.leer("rangoMin"))
		*!*	thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.txtAmarillo.value=str(thisform.oTblIndicadores.leer("rangoMed"))
		*!*	thisform.oTblIndicadores.IrPrimero()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE grabarmodificaciones
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		
		thisform.AddObject("oViewtabEfectivo"		,"Tg_ViewTabEfectivo")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblCaj_Saldos","Tg_tabla","caj_saldos","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblCaj_Valores","Tg_tabla","Caj_Valores")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblCaj_Cajas","Tg_tabla","Caj_Cajas")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblDatos_Monedas","Tg_tabla","monedas")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblIndicadores","Tg_tabla","tab_indicadores")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblValores","Tg_tabla","tab_valores")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblCajas","Tg_tabla","tab_cajas")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","Tg_tabla","tab_monedas")
		thisform.oTblMonedas.desfiltrar()
		thisform.oTblMonedas.filtrar("id_indicador='EFE'")
		thisform.oTblValores.desfiltrar()
		thisform.oTblValores.filtrar("id_indicador = 'EFE'")
		thisform.oTblCajas.desfiltrar()
		thisform.oTblCajas.filtrar("id_indicador = 'EFE'")
		
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblAux_Cajas"  , "Tg_Tabla", "Aux_tab_cajas")
		thisform.oTblAux_cajas.SetearProp ("BOT")
		thisform.oTblAux_cajas.Revertir()
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblAux_Valores"  , "Tg_Tabla", "Aux_tab_valores")
		thisform.oTblAux_Valores.SetearProp ("BOT")
		thisform.oTblAux_Valores.Revertir()
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblAux_monedas"  , "Tg_Tabla", "Aux_tab_monedas")
		thisform.oTblAux_monedas.SetearProp ("BOT")
		thisform.oTblAux_monedas.Revertir()
		
		ThisForm.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.Tg_cmbmonedas1.SetearTodos()
		ThisForm.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value ="TD"
		
		thisform.cargarTablas()
		thisform.cargarGrilla()
		
					
				
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarultimacotizacion
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE validardatos
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton1.Click
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Valores.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblAux_Valores.EsEof()
			If thisform.oTblAux_Valores.leer("seleccionado")
				If !thisform.oTblValores.buscar(thisform.oTblAux_Valores.leer("id_valor"),.f.,"CLAVE")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_indicador","EFE")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_valor",thisform.oTblAux_Valores.leer("id_valor"))
					thisform.oTblValores.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
				EndIf
			Else
				If thisform.oTblValores.buscar(thisform.oTblAux_Valores.leer("id_valor"),.f.,"CLAVE")
					thisform.oTblValores.borrar() 
				EndIf
			EndIf
			thisform.oTblAux_Valores.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblAux_Valores.IrPrimero()
		
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblAux_monedas.EsEof()
			If thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("seleccionado")
				If !thisform.oTblmonedas.buscar(thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("id_moneda")+str(thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("rango")),.f.,"CLAVE")
					** no encontre id + rango, agrego registro
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_indicador","EFE")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"rango",thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("rango"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"backColor",thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("backColor"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"foreColor",thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("foreColor"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_moneda",thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("id_moneda"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"nombre",thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("nombre"))
					** 26/03
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"esPos",IIF(thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("rango")>0,"T","F"))
					** 26/03
					thisform.oTblmonedas.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
				Else
					** encontre id+rango, modifico registro
					**=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"rango",thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("rango"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_indicador","EFE")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"backColor",thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("backColor"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"foreColor",thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("foreColor"))
					thisform.oTblmonedas.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
				EndIf
			Else
				If thisform.oTblmonedas.buscar(thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("id_moneda")+str(thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("rango")),.f.,"CLAVE")
					thisform.oTblmonedas.borrar() 
				EndIf
			EndIf
			thisform.oTblAux_monedas.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblAux_monedas.IrPrimero()
		
		
		thisform.oTblAux_monedas.desfiltrar()
		thisform.oTblmonedas.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblmonedas.EsEof()
			If !thisform.oTblAux_monedas.buscar(thisform.oTblmonedas.leer("id_moneda")+str(thisform.oTblmonedas.leer("rango")),.f.,"CLAVE")
				** no encuentro id+rango (se elimino o modifico)
				thisform.oTblmonedas.borrar()
			EndIf	
			thisform.oTblmonedas.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblmonedas.IrPrimero()
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Cajas.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblAux_Cajas.EsEof()
			If thisform.oTblAux_Cajas.leer("seleccionado")
				If !thisform.oTblCajas.buscar(thisform.oTblAux_Cajas.leer("id_Caja"),.f.,"CLAVE")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_indicador","EFE")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Caja",thisform.oTblAux_Cajas.leer("id_Caja"))
					thisform.oTblCajas.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
				EndIf
			Else
				If thisform.oTblCajas.buscar(thisform.oTblAux_Cajas.leer("id_Caja"),.f.,"CLAVE")
					thisform.oTblCajas.borrar() 
				EndIf
			EndIf
			thisform.oTblAux_Cajas.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblAux_Cajas.IrPrimero()
		
		
		This.Enabled = .F.
		thisform.lmodifico = .F.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton2.Click
		IF thisform.lModifico
			IF fMensPregunto("¿Desea descartar las modificaciones?","N",.F.) = "S"
				thisform.Release()
			ENDIF 
		ELSE 
			thisform.Release()
		ENDIF 
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page3.Tg_cmbmonedas1.InteractiveChange
		*** FILTRAR TABLA
		
		If thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.tg_cmbmonedas1.value = "TD"
			thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.desfiltrar()
		Else
			thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.filtrar("id_moneda=thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.tg_cmbmonedas1.value")
		EndIf	
			
		thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.fijarTag("CLAVE")
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.Tg_Grid1.Refresh()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page3.Tg_commandbutton1.Click
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.IrUltimo()
		iif(thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.tg_cmbmonedas1.value="TD",.t.,thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.buscar(thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.tg_cmbmonedas1.value,.f.,"CLAVE"))    
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_moneda",iif(thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.tg_cmbmonedas1.value="TD","",thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.tg_cmbmonedas1.value))
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"nombre",iif(thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.tg_cmbmonedas1.value="TD","",thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.leer("nombre")))
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.t.)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"rango",0)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"foreColor",16777215)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"backColor",16777215)
		thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.AgregaryModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.Tg_Grid1.Refresh()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page3.Tg_commandbutton2.Click
		If thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("rango") <> 0
			thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.borrar()
		
			If !thisform.oTblAux_monedas.buscar(thisform.oTblmonedas.leer("id_moneda")+str(thisform.oTblmonedas.leer("rango")),.f.,"CLAVE")
				thisform.oTblmonedas.borrar()
			EndIf	
				
			thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.Tg_Grid1.Refresh()
		Else
			** imprimir mensaje, no se puede eliminar el rango 0
		
		EndIf
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page3.Tg_grid1.AfterRowColChange
		LPARAMETERS nColIndex
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page3.Tg_grid1.BeforeRowColChange
		LPARAMETERS nColIndex
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page3.Tg_grid1.Column1.Tg_monedas1.InteractiveChange
		thisform.tg_commandbutton1.Enabled = .T.
		thisform.lmodifico = .T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page3.Tg_grid1.Column1.Tg_monedas1.LostFocus
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.Tg_Grid1.Refresh()
		thisform.tg_commandbutton1.Enabled = .T.
		thisform.lmodifico = .T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page3.Tg_grid1.Column2.Text1.LostFocus
		   
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page3.Tg_grid1.Column2.TG_CHECKBOX1.InteractiveChange
		thisform.tg_commandbutton1.Enabled = .T.
		thisform.lmodifico = .T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page3.Tg_grid1.Column2.TG_CHECKBOX1.LostFocus
		thisform.tg_commandbutton1.Enabled = .T.
		thisform.lmodifico = .T.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page3.Tg_grid1.Column3.Text1.InteractiveChange
		thisform.tg_commandbutton1.Enabled = .T.
		thisform.lmodifico = .T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page3.Tg_grid1.Column3.Text1.LostFocus
		thisform.tg_commandbutton1.Enabled = .T.
		thisform.lmodifico = .T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page3.Tg_grid1.Column4.Text1.InteractiveChange
		thisform.tg_commandbutton1.Enabled = .T.
		thisform.lmodifico = .T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page3.Tg_grid1.Column4.Text1.LostFocus
		thisform.tg_commandbutton1.Enabled = .T.
		thisform.lmodifico = .T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page3.Tg_grid1.Column4.Text1.RightClick
		this.BackColor = GetColor()
		this.foreColor = this.BackColor
		
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"backColor", this.BackColor)
		thisform.oTblAux_monedas.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page3.Tg_grid1.Refresh
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblAux_monedas.EsEof()
			thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.buscar(thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.leer("id_moneda"),.f.,"CLAVE")
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"nombre",thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.leer("nombre"))
			thisform.oTblAux_monedas.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
			thisform.oTblAux_monedas.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblAux_monedas.IrPrimero()
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE borrarrenglon
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargargrilla
		** AÑOS 
		ThisForm.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oTblAux_Anios.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Anios.Alias+".Anio"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Anios.Alias+".Inflacion"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Anios.Alias+".seleccionado"
		
		** MESES
		ThisForm.tg_grid2.RecordSourceType=1
		thisform.tg_grid2.RecordSource=thisform.oTblAux_Meses.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid2.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Meses.Alias+".Mes"
		thisform.tg_grid2.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Meses.Alias+".seleccionado"
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Anios.IrPrimero()
		thisform.oTblAux_Meses.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.Tg_Grid1.Refresh()
		thisform.Tg_Grid2.Refresh()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargarmonedas
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargartablas
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		** MESES
		For i=1 to 12 
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"mes",i)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.f.)
			thisform.oTblAux_Meses.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		EndFor
		
		thisform.oTblMeses.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblMeses.EsEof()
			thisform.oTblAux_Meses.buscar(thisform.oTblMeses.leer("mes"),.f.,"CLAVE")
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.t.)
			thisform.oTblAux_Meses.Modificar(@vGrabacion)
			thisform.oTblMeses.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblMeses.IrPrimero()
		
		
		** ANIOS
		
		nAnio = year(date())
		For i=0 to 9
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"anio",nAnio-i)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"inflacion",0)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.f.)
			thisform.oTblAux_Anios.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		EndFor
		
		thisform.oTblAnios.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblAnios.EsEof()
			thisform.oTblAux_Anios.buscar(thisform.oTblAnios.leer("anio"),.f.,"CLAVE")
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"inflacion",thisform.oTblAnios.Leer("inflacion"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.t.)
			thisform.oTblAux_Anios.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
			thisform.oTblAnios.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblAnios.IrPrimero()
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE grabarmodificaciones
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		
		thisform.AddObject("oViewTabEvolucionGastos"		,"tg_viewtabevolucionGastos")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblIndicadores","Tg_tabla","tab_indicadores")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblAnios","Tg_tabla","tab_anios")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMeses","Tg_tabla","tab_meses")
		thisform.oTblAnios.desfiltrar()
		thisform.oTblAnios.filtrar("id_indicador = 'EGA'")
		thisform.oTblMeses.desfiltrar()
		thisform.oTblMeses.filtrar("id_indicador = 'EGA'")
		
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblAux_Anios"  , "Tg_Tabla", "Aux_tab_Anios")
		thisform.oTblAux_Anios.SetearProp ("BOT")
		thisform.oTblAux_Anios.Revertir()
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblAux_Meses"  , "Tg_Tabla", "Aux_tab_Meses")
		thisform.oTblAux_Meses.SetearProp ("BOT")
		thisform.oTblAux_Meses.Revertir()
		
		thisform.cargarTablas()
		thisform.cargarGrilla()
		
					
				
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarultimacotizacion
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE validardatos
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton2.Click
		IF thisform.lModifico
			IF fMensPregunto("¿Desea descartar las modificaciones?","N",.F.) = "S"
				thisform.Release()
			ENDIF 
		ELSE 
			thisform.Release()
		ENDIF 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton3.Click
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Anios.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblAux_Anios.EsEof()
			If thisform.oTblAux_Anios.leer("seleccionado")
				If !thisform.oTblAnios.buscar(thisform.oTblAux_Anios.leer("Anio"),.f.,"CLAVE")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_indicador","EGA")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Anio",thisform.oTblAux_Anios.leer("Anio"))
					thisform.oTblAnios.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
				ELSE
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_indicador","EGA")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Inflacion",thisform.oTblAux_Anios.leer("Inflacion"))
					thisform.oTblAnios.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
				EndIf
			Else
				If thisform.oTblAnios.buscar(thisform.oTblAux_Anios.leer("Anio"),.f.,"CLAVE")
					thisform.oTblAnios.borrar() 
				EndIf
			EndIf
			thisform.oTblAux_Anios.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblAux_Anios.IrPrimero()
		
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Meses.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblAux_Meses.EsEof()
			If thisform.oTblAux_Meses.leer("seleccionado")
				If !thisform.oTblMeses.buscar(thisform.oTblAux_Meses.leer("Mes"),.f.,"CLAVE")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_indicador","EGA")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"mes",thisform.oTblAux_Meses.leer("Mes"))
					thisform.oTblMeses.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
				EndIf
			Else
				If thisform.oTblMeses.buscar(thisform.oTblAux_Meses.leer("Mes"),.f.,"CLAVE")
					thisform.oTblMeses.borrar() 
				EndIf
			EndIf
			thisform.oTblAux_Meses.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblAux_Meses.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.tg_commandbutton2.SetFocus()
		This.Enabled = .F.
		thisform.lmodifico = .F.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.AfterRowColChange
		LPARAMETERS nColIndex
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.BeforeRowColChange

	ENDPROC

		thisform.lmodifico = .T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid2.Column3.TG_CHECKBOX1.LostFocus

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE agregarrenglon
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE borrarrenglon
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargargrilla
		** AÑOS
		ThisForm.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oTblAux_Anios.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Anios.Alias+".Anio"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Anios.Alias+".Inflacion"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Anios.Alias+".seleccionado"
		
		** MESES
		ThisForm.tg_grid2.RecordSourceType=1
		thisform.tg_grid2.RecordSource=thisform.oTblAux_Meses.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid2.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Meses.Alias+".Mes"
		thisform.tg_grid2.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Meses.Alias+".seleccionado"
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Anios.IrPrimero()
		thisform.oTblAux_Meses.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.Tg_Grid1.Refresh()
		thisform.Tg_Grid2.Refresh()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargarmonedas
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargartablas
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		** MESES
		For i=1 to 12 
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"mes",i)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.f.)
			thisform.oTblAux_Meses.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		EndFor
		
		thisform.oTblMeses.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblMeses.EsEof()
			thisform.oTblAux_Meses.buscar(thisform.oTblMeses.leer("mes"),.f.,"CLAVE")
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.t.)
			thisform.oTblAux_Meses.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
			thisform.oTblMeses.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblMeses.IrPrimero()
		
		
		** ANIOS
		
		nAnio = year(date())
		For i=0 to 9
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"anio",nAnio-i)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"inflacion",0)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.f.)
			thisform.oTblAux_Anios.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		EndFor
		
		thisform.oTblAnios.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblAnios.EsEof()
			thisform.oTblAux_Anios.buscar(thisform.oTblAnios.leer("anio"),.f.,"CLAVE")
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"inflacion",thisform.oTblAnios.Leer("inflacion"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.t.)
			thisform.oTblAux_Anios.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
			thisform.oTblAnios.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblAnios.IrPrimero()
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE grabarmodificaciones
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		
		thisform.AddObject("oViewTabEvolucionVentas"		,"tg_viewtabevolucionventas")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblIndicadores","Tg_tabla","tab_indicadores")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblAnios","Tg_tabla","tab_anios")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMeses","Tg_tabla","tab_meses")
		thisform.oTblAnios.desfiltrar()
		thisform.oTblAnios.filtrar("id_indicador = 'EVA'")
		thisform.oTblMeses.desfiltrar()
		thisform.oTblMeses.filtrar("id_indicador = 'EVA'")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblAux_Anios"  , "Tg_Tabla", "Aux_tab_Anios")
		thisform.oTblAux_Anios.SetearProp ("BOT")
		thisform.oTblAux_Anios.Revertir()
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblAux_Meses"  , "Tg_Tabla", "Aux_tab_Meses")
		thisform.oTblAux_Meses.SetearProp ("BOT")
		thisform.oTblAux_Meses.Revertir()
		
		thisform.cargarTablas()
		thisform.cargarGrilla()
		
					
				
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE LostFocus
		thisform.tg_commandbutton3.Enabled = .T.
		thisform.lmodifico = .T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarultimacotizacion
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE validardatos
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton2.Click
		IF thisform.lModifico
			IF fMensPregunto("¿Desea descartar las modificaciones?","N",.F.) = "S"
				thisform.Release()
			ENDIF 
		ELSE 
			thisform.Release()
		ENDIF 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton3.Click
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Anios.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblAux_Anios.EsEof()
			If thisform.oTblAux_Anios.leer("seleccionado")
				If !thisform.oTblAnios.buscar(thisform.oTblAux_Anios.leer("Anio"),.f.,"CLAVE")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_indicador","EVA")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Anio",thisform.oTblAux_Anios.leer("Anio"))
					thisform.oTblAnios.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
				ELSE
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_indicador","EVA")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Inflacion",thisform.oTblAux_Anios.leer("Inflacion"))
					thisform.oTblAnios.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
				EndIf	
			Else
				If thisform.oTblAnios.buscar(thisform.oTblAux_Anios.leer("Anio"),.f.,"CLAVE")
					thisform.oTblAnios.borrar() 
				EndIf
			EndIf
			thisform.oTblAux_Anios.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblAux_Anios.IrPrimero()
		
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Meses.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblAux_Meses.EsEof()
			If thisform.oTblAux_Meses.leer("seleccionado")
				If !thisform.oTblMeses.buscar(thisform.oTblAux_Meses.leer("Mes"),.f.,"CLAVE")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_indicador","EVA")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"mes",thisform.oTblAux_Meses.leer("Mes"))
					thisform.oTblMeses.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
				EndIf
			Else
				If thisform.oTblMeses.buscar(thisform.oTblAux_Meses.leer("Mes"),.f.,"CLAVE")
					thisform.oTblMeses.borrar() 
				EndIf
			EndIf
			thisform.oTblAux_Meses.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblAux_Meses.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.tg_commandbutton2.SetFocus()
		This.Enabled = .F.
		thisform.lmodifico = .F.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.AfterRowColChange
		LPARAMETERS nColIndex
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.BeforeRowColChange
		LPARAMETERS nColIndex
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column2.Text1.InteractiveChange
		thisform.tg_commandbutton3.Enabled = .T.
		thisform.lmodifico = .T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column2.Text1.LostFocus
		thisform.tg_commandbutton3.Enabled = .T.
		thisform.lmodifico = .T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column3.TG_CHECKBOX1.InteractiveChange
		thisform.tg_commandbutton3.Enabled = .T.
		thisform.lmodifico = .T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column3.TG_CHECKBOX1.LostFocus
		thisform.tg_commandbutton3.Enabled = .T.
		thisform.lmodifico = .T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid2.AfterRowColChange
		LPARAMETERS nColIndex
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid2.BeforeRowColChange
		LPARAMETERS nColIndex
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid2.Column3.TG_CHECKBOX1.InteractiveChange
		thisform.tg_commandbutton3.Enabled = .T.
		thisform.lmodifico = .T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid2.Column3.TG_CHECKBOX1.LostFocus
		thisform.tg_commandbutton3.Enabled = .T.
		thisform.lmodifico = .T.
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE borrarrenglon
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargargrilla
		** AÑOS
		ThisForm.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oTblAux_Anios.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Anios.Alias+".Anio"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Anios.Alias+".Inflacion"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Anios.Alias+".seleccionado"
		
		** MESES
		ThisForm.tg_grid2.RecordSourceType=1
		thisform.tg_grid2.RecordSource=thisform.oTblAux_Meses.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid2.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Meses.Alias+".Mes"
		thisform.tg_grid2.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Meses.Alias+".seleccionado"
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Anios.IrPrimero()
		thisform.oTblAux_Meses.IrPrimero()
		
		
		thisform.Tg_Grid1.Refresh()
		thisform.Tg_Grid2.Refresh()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargarmonedas
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargartablas
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		** MESES
		For i=1 to 12 
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"mes",i)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.f.)
			thisform.oTblAux_Meses.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		EndFor
		
		thisform.oTblMeses.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblMeses.EsEof()
			thisform.oTblAux_Meses.buscar(thisform.oTblMeses.leer("mes"),.f.,"CLAVE")
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.t.)
			thisform.oTblAux_Meses.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
			thisform.oTblMeses.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblMeses.IrPrimero()
		
		
		** ANIOS
		
		nAnio = year(date())
		For i=0 to 9
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"anio",nAnio-i)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"inflacion",0)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.f.)
			thisform.oTblAux_Anios.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		EndFor
		
		thisform.oTblAnios.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblAnios.EsEof()
			thisform.oTblAux_Anios.buscar(thisform.oTblAnios.leer("anio"),.f.,"CLAVE")
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"inflacion",thisform.oTblAnios.Leer("inflacion"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.t.)
			thisform.oTblAux_Anios.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
			thisform.oTblAnios.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblAnios.IrPrimero()
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE grabarmodificaciones
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		
		thisform.AddObject("oViewTabEvolucionVentasSucursales"		,"tg_viewTabEvolucionVentasSucursales")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblIndicadores","Tg_tabla","tab_indicadores")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblAnios","Tg_tabla","tab_anios")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMeses","Tg_tabla","tab_meses")
		thisform.oTblAnios.desfiltrar()
		thisform.oTblAnios.filtrar("id_indicador = 'EVS'")
		thisform.oTblMeses.desfiltrar()
		thisform.oTblMeses.filtrar("id_indicador = 'EVS'")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblAux_Anios"  , "Tg_Tabla", "Aux_tab_Anios")
		thisform.oTblAux_Anios.SetearProp ("BOT")
		thisform.oTblAux_Anios.Revertir()
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblAux_Meses"  , "Tg_Tabla", "Aux_tab_Meses")
		thisform.oTblAux_Meses.SetearProp ("BOT")
		thisform.oTblAux_Meses.Revertir()
		
		thisform.cargarTablas()
		thisform.cargarGrilla()
		
					
				
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarultimacotizacion
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE validardatos
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton2.Click
		IF thisform.lModifico
			IF fMensPregunto("¿Desea descartar las modificaciones?","N",.F.) = "S"
				thisform.Release()
			ENDIF 
		ELSE 
			thisform.Release()
		ENDIF 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton3.Click
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Anios.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblAux_Anios.EsEof()
			If thisform.oTblAux_Anios.leer("seleccionado")
				If !thisform.oTblAnios.buscar(thisform.oTblAux_Anios.leer("Anio"),.f.,"CLAVE")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_indicador","EVS")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Anio",thisform.oTblAux_Anios.leer("Anio"))
					thisform.oTblAnios.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
				ELSE
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_indicador","EVS")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Inflacion",thisform.oTblAux_Anios.leer("Inflacion"))
					thisform.oTblAnios.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
				EndIf	
			Else
				If thisform.oTblAnios.buscar(thisform.oTblAux_Anios.leer("Anio"),.f.,"CLAVE")
					thisform.oTblAnios.borrar() 
				EndIf
			EndIf
			thisform.oTblAux_Anios.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblAux_Anios.IrPrimero()
		
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Meses.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblAux_Meses.EsEof()
			If thisform.oTblAux_Meses.leer("seleccionado")
				If !thisform.oTblMeses.buscar(thisform.oTblAux_Meses.leer("Mes"),.f.,"CLAVE")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_indicador","EVS")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"mes",thisform.oTblAux_Meses.leer("Mes"))
					thisform.oTblMeses.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
				EndIf
			Else
				If thisform.oTblMeses.buscar(thisform.oTblAux_Meses.leer("Mes"),.f.,"CLAVE")
					thisform.oTblMeses.borrar() 
				EndIf
			EndIf
			thisform.oTblAux_Meses.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblAux_Meses.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.tg_commandbutton2.SetFocus()
		This.Enabled = .F.
		thisform.lmodifico = .F.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.AfterRowColChange
		LPARAMETERS nColIndex
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.BeforeRowColChange

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargargrilla
		Local vGrabacion,nCantidadCotizaciones
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		ThisForm.Tg_PageFrame1.Page1.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page1.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.Alias
		
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page1.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.Alias+".id_Comproba"
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page1.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.Alias+".nombre"
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page1.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.Alias+".seleccionado"
		
		
		ThisForm.Tg_PageFrame1.Page4.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page4.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oTblAux_itemsCompra.Alias
		
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page4.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_itemsCompra.Alias+".id_item"
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page4.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_itemsCompra.Alias+".nombre"
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page4.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_itemsCompra.Alias+".seleccionado"
		
		
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.Alias
		
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.Alias+".id_moneda"
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.Alias+".nombre"
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.Alias+".seleccionado"
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.Alias+".rango"
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.Alias+".backcolor"
		
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.tg_grid1.Column4.DynamicBackColor = "thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.Leer('backcolor')"
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.tg_grid1.Column4.DynamicForeColor = "thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.Leer('backcolor')"
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.IrPrimero()
		thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.IrPrimero()
		thisform.oTblAux_itemsCompra.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.fijarTag("CLAVE")
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page1.Tg_Grid1.Refresh()
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.Tg_Grid1.Refresh()
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page4.Tg_Grid1.Refresh()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargarmonedas
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		** Cargo la tabla auxiliar con las distintas monedas
		thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.EsEof()
			If thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.Leer("id_moneda")=ThisForm.Tg_PageFrame1.page2.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value or ThisForm.Tg_PageFrame1.page2.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value="TD"
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_moneda",thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.Leer("id_moneda"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"nombre",thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.Leer("nombre"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.t.)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"rango",0)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"foreColor",16777215)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"backColor",16777215)
				thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
			EndIf
			thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.IrPrimero()
		
		
		** MODIFICO LA GRILLA CAMBIANDO LOS VALORES O AGREGANDO NUEVOS SEGUN CORRESPONDA.
		thisform.oTblMonedas.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblMonedas.EsEof()
			If thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.buscar(thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("id_moneda")+str(thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("rango")),.f.,"CLAVE")
				** encontre id y rango, modifico con lo qe corresponde
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.t.)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"rango",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("rango"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"backColor",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("backColor"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"foreColor",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("foreColor"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_moneda",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("id_moneda"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"nombre",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("nombre"))
				thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
			Else
				** encontre id pero no rango, agrego nuevo registro
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.t.)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"rango",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("rango"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"backColor",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("backColor"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"foreColor",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("foreColor"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_moneda",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("id_moneda"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"nombre",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("nombre"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_moneda",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("id_moneda"))
				thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
			EndIf
			thisform.oTblMonedas.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblMonedas.IrPrimero()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargartablas
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		** COMPROBANTES
		thisform.oTblDatos_Comprobantes.IrPrimero()
		Do While !thisform.oTblDatos_Comprobantes.EsEof()
			If thisform.oTblDatos_Comprobantes.Leer("remunerativo") AND !thisform.oTblDatos_Comprobantes.Leer("pago")
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_Comproba",thisform.oTblDatos_Comprobantes.Leer("id_Comproba"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"nombre",thisform.oTblDatos_Comprobantes.Leer("nombre"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.f.)
				thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
			EndIf
			thisform.oTblDatos_Comprobantes.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		
		thisform.oTblComprobantes.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblComprobantes.EsEof()
			thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.buscar(thisform.oTblComprobantes.leer("id_Comproba"),.f.,"CLAVE")
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.t.)
			thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
			thisform.oTblComprobantes.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblComprobantes.IrPrimero()
		
		
		** ITEMS DE COMPRA
		thisform.oTblDatos_Items.IrPrimero()
		Do While !thisform.oTblDatos_Items.EsEof()
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_Item",thisform.oTblDatos_Items.Leer("id_ItemCompra"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"nombre",thisform.oTblDatos_Items.Leer("nombre"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.f.)
			thisform.oTblAux_ItemsCompra.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
			thisform.oTblDatos_Items.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblDatos_Items.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.oTblItems.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblItems.EsEof()
			thisform.oTblAux_itemsCompra.buscar(thisform.oTblItems.leer("id_item"),.f.,"CLAVE")
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.t.)
			thisform.oTblAux_itemsCompra.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
			thisform.oTblItems.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblItems.IrPrimero()
		
		** DIAS
		thisform.oTblIndicadores.irPrimero()
		thisform.oTblIndicadores.buscar("GAS",.f.,"CLAVE")
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.oTxtFechaDesde.value = thisform.oTblIndicadores.Leer("fechaDesde")
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.oTxtFechaHasta.value = thisform.oTblIndicadores.Leer("fechaHasta")
		thisform.oTblIndicadores.irPrimero()	
		
		thisform.cargarMonedas()
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE grabarmodificaciones
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		
		thisform.AddObject("oViewtabGastos"		,"Tg_ViewTabGastos")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblDatos_Items","Tg_tabla","itemsCompras")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblDatos_Comprobantes","Tg_tabla","cmp_docu","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblDatos_Monedas","Tg_tabla","monedas")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblIndicadores","Tg_tabla","tab_indicadores")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblComprobantes","Tg_tabla","tab_Comprobantes")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblItems","Tg_tabla","tab_ItemsCompra")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","Tg_tabla","tab_monedas")
		thisform.oTblMonedas.desfiltrar()
		thisform.oTblMonedas.filtrar("id_indicador='GAS'")
		thisform.oTblComprobantes.desfiltrar()
		thisform.oTblComprobantes.filtrar("id_indicador='GAS'")
		thisform.oTblItems.desfiltrar()
		thisform.oTblItems.filtrar("id_indicador='GAS'")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblAux_Comprobantes"  , "Tg_Tabla", "Aux_tab_Comprobantes")
		thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.SetearProp ("BOT")
		thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.Revertir()
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblAux_ItemsCompra"  , "Tg_Tabla", "Aux_tab_ItemsCompra")
		thisform.oTblAux_ItemsCompra.SetearProp ("BOT")
		thisform.oTblAux_ItemsCompra.Revertir()
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblAux_monedas"  , "Tg_Tabla", "Aux_tab_monedas")
		thisform.oTblAux_monedas.SetearProp ("BOT")
		thisform.oTblAux_monedas.Revertir()
		
		ThisForm.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.Tg_cmbmonedas1.SetearTodos()
		ThisForm.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value ="TD"
		
		thisform.cargarTablas()
		thisform.cargarGrilla()
		
					
				
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarultimacotizacion
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE validardatos
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton1.Click
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.oTblAux_itemsCompra.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblAux_itemsCompra.EsEof()
			If thisform.oTblAux_itemsCompra.leer("seleccionado")
				If !thisform.oTblItems.buscar(thisform.oTblAux_itemsCompra.leer("id_item"),.f.,"CLAVE")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_indicador","GAS")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_item",thisform.oTblAux_itemsCompra.leer("id_item"))
					thisform.oTblItems.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
				EndIf
			Else
				If thisform.oTblItems.buscar(thisform.oTblAux_itemsCompra.leer("id_item"),.f.,"CLAVE")
					thisform.oTblItems.borrar() 
				EndIf
			EndIf
			thisform.oTblAux_itemsCompra.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblAux_itemsCompra.IrPrimero()
		
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.EsEof()
			If thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.leer("seleccionado")
				If !thisform.oTblComprobantes.buscar(thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.leer("id_comproba"),.f.,"CLAVE")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_indicador","GAS")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_comproba",thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.leer("id_comproba"))
					thisform.oTblComprobantes.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
				EndIf
			Else
				If thisform.oTblComprobantes.buscar(thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.leer("id_comproba"),.f.,"CLAVE")
					thisform.oTblComprobantes.borrar() 
				EndIf
			EndIf
			thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.IrPrimero()
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblAux_monedas.EsEof()
			If thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("seleccionado")
				If !thisform.oTblmonedas.buscar(thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("id_moneda")+str(thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("rango")),.f.,"CLAVE")
					** no encontre id + rango, agrego registro
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_indicador","GAS")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"rango",thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("rango"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"backColor",thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("backColor"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"foreColor",thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("foreColor"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_moneda",thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("id_moneda"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"nombre",thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("nombre"))
					** 26/03
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"esPos",IIF(thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("rango")>0,"T","F"))
					** 26/03
					thisform.oTblmonedas.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
				Else
					** encontre id+rango, modifico registro
					**=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"rango",thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("rango"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_indicador","GAS")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"backColor",thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("backColor"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"foreColor",thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("foreColor"))
					thisform.oTblmonedas.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
				EndIf
			Else
				If thisform.oTblmonedas.buscar(thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("id_moneda")+str(thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("rango")),.f.,"CLAVE")
					thisform.oTblmonedas.borrar() 
				EndIf
			EndIf
			thisform.oTblAux_monedas.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblAux_monedas.IrPrimero()
		
		
		thisform.oTblAux_monedas.desfiltrar()
		thisform.oTblmonedas.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblmonedas.EsEof()
			If !thisform.oTblAux_monedas.buscar(thisform.oTblmonedas.leer("id_moneda")+str(thisform.oTblmonedas.leer("rango")),.f.,"CLAVE")
				** no encuentro id+rango (se elimino o modifico)
				thisform.oTblmonedas.borrar()
			EndIf	
			thisform.oTblmonedas.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblmonedas.IrPrimero()
		
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.oTblIndicadores.irPrimero()
		thisform.oTblIndicadores.buscar("GAS",.f.,"CLAVE")
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"fechadesde",thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.oTxtFechaDesde.value)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"fechahasta",thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.oTxtFechaHasta.value)
		thisform.oTblIndicadores.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		thisform.oTblIndicadores.irPrimero()
		
		This.Enabled = .F.
		thisform.lmodifico = .F.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton5.Click
		IF thisform.lModifico
			IF fMensPregunto("¿Desea descartar las modificaciones?","N",.F.) = "S"
				thisform.Release()
			ENDIF 
		ELSE 
			thisform.Release()
		ENDIF 
	ENDPROC

		thisform.lmodifico = .T.
	ENDPROC

		thisform.lmodifico = .T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page2.Tg_cmbmonedas1.InteractiveChange
		*** FILTRAR TABLA
		
		If thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.page2.tg_cmbmonedas1.value = "TD"
			thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.desfiltrar()
		Else
			thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.filtrar("id_moneda=thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.page2.tg_cmbmonedas1.value")
		EndIf	
			
		thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.fijarTag("CLAVE")
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.page2.Tg_Grid1.Refresh()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page2.Tg_commandbutton2.Click
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.IrUltimo()
		iif(thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.tg_cmbmonedas1.value="TD",.t.,thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.buscar(thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.page2.tg_cmbmonedas1.value,.f.,"CLAVE"))    
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_moneda",iif(thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.page2.tg_cmbmonedas1.value="TD","",thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.page2.tg_cmbmonedas1.value))
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"nombre",iif(thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.page2.tg_cmbmonedas1.value="TD","",thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.leer("nombre")))
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.t.)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"rango",0)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"foreColor",16777215)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"backColor",16777215)
		thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.AgregaryModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.page2.Tg_Grid1.Refresh()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page2.Tg_commandbutton4.Click
		If thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("rango") <> 0
			thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.borrar()
		
			If !thisform.oTblAux_monedas.buscar(thisform.oTblmonedas.leer("id_moneda")+str(thisform.oTblmonedas.leer("rango")),.f.,"CLAVE")
				thisform.oTblmonedas.borrar()
			EndIf	
				
			thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.page2.Tg_Grid1.Refresh()
		Else
			** imprimir mensaje, no se puede eliminar el rango 0
		
		EndIf
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page2.Tg_grid1.AfterRowColChange
		LPARAMETERS nColIndex
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page2.Tg_grid1.BeforeRowColChange
		LPARAMETERS nColIndex

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page2.Tg_grid1.Column4.Text1.RightClick
		this.BackColor = GetColor()
		this.foreColor = this.BackColor
		
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"backColor", this.BackColor)
		thisform.oTblAux_monedas.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page2.Tg_grid1.Refresh
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblAux_monedas.EsEof()
			thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.buscar(thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.leer("id_moneda"),.f.,"CLAVE")
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"nombre",thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.leer("nombre"))
			thisform.oTblAux_monedas.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
			thisform.oTblAux_monedas.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblAux_monedas.IrPrimero()
	ENDPROC

		thisform.lmodifico = .T.

	PROCEDURE cargargrilla
		ThisForm.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oTblPaginas.Alias

	PROCEDURE cargargrilla
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		ThisForm.Tg_PageFrame1.Page1.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page1.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.Alias
		
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page1.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.Alias+".id_comproba"
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page1.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.Alias+".nombre"
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page1.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.Alias+".seleccionado"
		
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.Alias
		
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.Alias+".id_moneda"
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.Alias+".nombre"
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.Alias+".seleccionado"
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.Alias+".rango"
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.Alias+".backcolor"
		
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.tg_grid1.Column4.DynamicBackColor = "thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.Leer('backcolor')"
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.tg_grid1.Column4.DynamicForeColor = "thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.Leer('backcolor')"
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.IrPrimero()
		thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page1.Tg_Grid1.Refresh()
		thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.fijarTag("CLAVE")
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.Tg_Grid1.Refresh()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargarmonedas
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		** Cargo la tabla auxiliar con las distintas monedas
		thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.EsEof()
			If thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.Leer("id_moneda")=ThisForm.Tg_PageFrame1.page2.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value or ThisForm.Tg_PageFrame1.page2.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value="TD"
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_moneda",thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.Leer("id_moneda"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"nombre",thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.Leer("nombre"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.t.)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"rango",0)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"foreColor",16777215)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"backColor",16777215)
				thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
			EndIf
			thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.IrPrimero()
		
		
		** MODIFICO LA GRILLA CAMBIANDO LOS VALORES O AGREGANDO NUEVOS SEGUN CORRESPONDA.
		thisform.oTblMonedas.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblMonedas.EsEof()
			If thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.buscar(thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("id_moneda")+str(thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("rango")),.f.,"CLAVE")
				** encontre id y rango, modifico con lo qe corresponde
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.t.)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"rango",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("rango"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"backColor",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("backColor"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"foreColor",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("foreColor"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_moneda",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("id_moneda"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"nombre",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("nombre"))
				thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
			Else
				** encontre id pero no rango, agrego nuevo registro
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.t.)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"rango",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("rango"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"backColor",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("backColor"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"foreColor",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("foreColor"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_moneda",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("id_moneda"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"nombre",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("nombre"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_moneda",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("id_moneda"))
				thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
			EndIf
			thisform.oTblMonedas.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblMonedas.IrPrimero()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargartablas
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		** COMPROBANTES
		thisform.oTblDocu.IrPrimero()
		Do While !thisform.oTblDocu.EsEof()
			If thisform.oTblDocu.Leer("cobranza") AND thisform.oTblDocu.Leer("remunerativo")
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_comproba",thisform.oTblDocu.Leer("id_comproba"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"nombre",thisform.oTblDocu.Leer("nombre"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.f.)
				thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
			EndIf
			thisform.oTblDocu.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblDocu.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.oTblComprobantes.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblComprobantes.EsEof()
			thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.buscar(thisform.oTblComprobantes.leer("id_comproba"),.f.,"CLAVE")
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.t.)
			thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
			thisform.oTblComprobantes.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblComprobantes.IrPrimero()
		
		** DIAS
		thisform.oTblIndicadores.irPrimero()
		thisform.oTblIndicadores.buscar("PDC",.f.,"CLAVE")
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.oTxtFechaDesde.value = thisform.oTblIndicadores.Leer("fechaDesde")
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.oTxtFechaHasta.value = thisform.oTblIndicadores.Leer("fechaHasta")
		thisform.oTblIndicadores.irPrimero()	
					
		
		thisform.cargarMonedas()
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE grabarmodificaciones
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		
		thisform.AddObject("oViewtabPromedioCobranzas"		,"Tg_ViewTabPromedioCobranzas")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblDocu","Tg_tabla","vnt_docu","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblDatos_Monedas","Tg_tabla","monedas")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblIndicadores","Tg_tabla","tab_indicadores")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblComprobantes","Tg_tabla","tab_Comprobantes")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","Tg_tabla","tab_monedas")
		thisform.oTblMonedas.desfiltrar()
		thisform.oTblMonedas.filtrar("id_indicador='PDC'")
		thisform.oTblComprobantes.desfiltrar()
		thisform.oTblComprobantes.filtrar("id_indicador = 'PDC'")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblAux_Comprobantes"  , "Tg_Tabla", "Aux_tab_Comprobantes")
		thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.SetearProp ("BOT")
		thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.Revertir()
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblAux_monedas"  , "Tg_Tabla", "Aux_tab_monedas")
		thisform.oTblAux_monedas.SetearProp ("BOT")
		thisform.oTblAux_monedas.Revertir()
		
		ThisForm.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.Tg_cmbmonedas1.SetearTodos()
		ThisForm.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value ="TD"
		
		thisform.cargarTablas()
		thisform.cargarGrilla()
		
					
				
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarultimacotizacion
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE validardatos
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton1.Click
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblAux_monedas.EsEof()
			If thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("seleccionado")
				If !thisform.oTblmonedas.buscar(thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("id_moneda")+str(thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("rango")),.f.,"CLAVE")
					** no encontre id + rango, agrego registro
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_indicador","PDC")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"rango",thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("rango"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"backColor",thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("backColor"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"foreColor",thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("foreColor"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_moneda",thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("id_moneda"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"nombre",thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("nombre"))
					** 26/03
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"esPos",IIF(thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("rango")>0,"T","F"))
					** 26/03
					thisform.oTblmonedas.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
				Else
					** encontre id+rango, modifico registro
					**=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"rango",thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("rango"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_indicador","PDC")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"backColor",thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("backColor"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"foreColor",thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("foreColor"))
					thisform.oTblmonedas.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
				EndIf
			Else
				If thisform.oTblmonedas.buscar(thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("id_moneda")+str(thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("rango")),.f.,"CLAVE")
					thisform.oTblmonedas.borrar() 
				EndIf
			EndIf
			thisform.oTblAux_monedas.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblAux_monedas.IrPrimero()
		
		
		thisform.oTblAux_monedas.desfiltrar()
		thisform.oTblmonedas.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblmonedas.EsEof()
			If !thisform.oTblAux_monedas.buscar(thisform.oTblmonedas.leer("id_moneda")+str(thisform.oTblmonedas.leer("rango")),.f.,"CLAVE")
				** no encuentro id+rango (se elimino o modifico)
				thisform.oTblmonedas.borrar()
			EndIf	
			thisform.oTblmonedas.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblmonedas.IrPrimero()
		
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.oTblIndicadores.irPrimero()
		thisform.oTblIndicadores.buscar("PDC",.f.,"CLAVE")
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"fechadesde",thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.oTxtFechaDesde.value)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"fechahasta",thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.oTxtFechaHasta.value)
		thisform.oTblIndicadores.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		thisform.oTblIndicadores.irPrimero()	
					
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.EsEof()
			If thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.leer("seleccionado")
				If !thisform.oTblComprobantes.buscar(thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.leer("id_comproba"),.f.,"CLAVE")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_indicador","PDC")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_comproba",thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.leer("id_comproba"))
					thisform.oTblComprobantes.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
				EndIf
			Else
				If thisform.oTblComprobantes.buscar(thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.leer("id_comproba"),.f.,"CLAVE")
					thisform.oTblComprobantes.borrar() 
				EndIf
			EndIf
			thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.IrPrimero()		
					
					
		this.Enabled = .F.
		thisform.lmodifico = .F.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton5.Click
		IF thisform.lModifico
			IF fMensPregunto("¿Desea descartar las modificaciones?","N",.F.) = "S"
				thisform.Release()
			ENDIF 
		ELSE 
			thisform.Release()
		ENDIF 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page1.Tg_grid1.Column3.TG_CHECKBOX1.InteractiveChange
		thisform.tg_commandbutton1.Enabled = .T.
		thisform.lmodifico = .T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page1.Tg_grid1.Column3.TG_CHECKBOX1.LostFocus
		thisform.tg_commandbutton1.Enabled = .T.
		thisform.lmodifico = .T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page2.Tg_cmbmonedas1.InteractiveChange
		*** FILTRAR TABLA
		
		If thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.page2.tg_cmbmonedas1.value = "TD"
			thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.desfiltrar()
		Else
			thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.filtrar("id_moneda=thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.page2.tg_cmbmonedas1.value")
		EndIf	
			
		thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.fijarTag("CLAVE")
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.page2.Tg_Grid1.Refresh()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page2.Tg_commandbutton2.Click
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.IrUltimo()
		iif(thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.tg_cmbmonedas1.value="TD",.t.,thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.buscar(thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.page2.tg_cmbmonedas1.value,.f.,"CLAVE"))    
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_moneda",iif(thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.page2.tg_cmbmonedas1.value="TD","",thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.page2.tg_cmbmonedas1.value))
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"nombre",iif(thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.page2.tg_cmbmonedas1.value="TD","",thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.leer("nombre")))
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.t.)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"rango",0)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"foreColor",16777215)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"backColor",16777215)
		thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.AgregaryModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.page2.Tg_Grid1.Refresh()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page2.Tg_commandbutton4.Click
		If thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("rango") <> 0
			thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.borrar()
		
			If !thisform.oTblAux_monedas.buscar(thisform.oTblmonedas.leer("id_moneda")+str(thisform.oTblmonedas.leer("rango")),.f.,"CLAVE")
				thisform.oTblmonedas.borrar()
			EndIf	
				
			thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.page2.Tg_Grid1.Refresh()
		Else
			** imprimir mensaje, no se puede eliminar el rango 0
		
		EndIf
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page2.Tg_grid1.Column4.Text1.RightClick
		this.BackColor = GetColor()
		this.foreColor = this.BackColor
		
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"backColor", this.BackColor)
		thisform.oTblAux_monedas.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page2.Tg_grid1.Refresh
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblAux_monedas.EsEof()
			thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.buscar(thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.leer("id_moneda"),.f.,"CLAVE")
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"nombre",thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.leer("nombre"))
			thisform.oTblAux_monedas.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
			thisform.oTblAux_monedas.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblAux_monedas.IrPrimero()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page3.oTxtFechaDesde.Click
		thisform.tg_commandbutton1.Enabled = .T.
		thisform.lmodifico = .T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page3.oTxtFechaDesde.InteractiveChange
		thisform.tg_commandbutton1.Enabled = .T.
		thisform.lmodifico = .T.
	ENDPROC

		thisform.lmodifico = .T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page3.oTxtFechaHasta.InteractiveChange
		thisform.tg_commandbutton1.Enabled = .T.
		thisform.lmodifico = .T.
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

		Top = 41, ;
		Width = 96
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="..\lib\tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="label" />
	
	PROCEDURE agregarrenglon
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE borrarrenglon
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargargrilla
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		ThisForm.Tg_PageFrame1.Page1.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page1.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.Alias
		
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page1.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.Alias+".id_comproba"
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page1.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.Alias+".nombre"
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page1.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.Alias+".seleccionado"
		
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.Alias
		
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.Alias+".id_moneda"
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.Alias+".nombre"
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.Alias+".seleccionado"
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.Alias+".rango"
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.Alias+".backcolor"
		
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.tg_grid1.Column4.DynamicBackColor = "thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.Leer('backcolor')"
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.tg_grid1.Column4.DynamicForeColor = "thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.Leer('backcolor')"
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.IrPrimero()
		thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page1.Tg_Grid1.Refresh()
		thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.fijarTag("CLAVE")
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.Tg_Grid1.Refresh()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargarmonedas
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		** Cargo la tabla auxiliar con las distintas monedas
		thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.EsEof()
			If thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.Leer("id_moneda")=ThisForm.Tg_PageFrame1.page2.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value or ThisForm.Tg_PageFrame1.page2.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value="TD"
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_moneda",thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.Leer("id_moneda"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"nombre",thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.Leer("nombre"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.t.)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"rango",0)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"foreColor",16777215)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"backColor",16777215)
				thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
			EndIf
			thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.IrPrimero()
		
		
		** MODIFICO LA GRILLA CAMBIANDO LOS VALORES O AGREGANDO NUEVOS SEGUN CORRESPONDA.
		thisform.oTblMonedas.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblMonedas.EsEof()
			If thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.buscar(thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("id_moneda")+str(thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("rango")),.f.,"CLAVE")
				** encontre id y rango, modifico con lo qe corresponde
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.t.)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"rango",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("rango"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"backColor",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("backColor"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"foreColor",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("foreColor"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_moneda",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("id_moneda"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"nombre",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("nombre"))
				thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
			Else
				** encontre id pero no rango, agrego nuevo registro
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.t.)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"rango",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("rango"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"backColor",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("backColor"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"foreColor",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("foreColor"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_moneda",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("id_moneda"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"nombre",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("nombre"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_moneda",thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("id_moneda"))
				thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
			EndIf
			thisform.oTblMonedas.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblMonedas.IrPrimero()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargartablas
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		** COMPROBANTES
		thisform.oTblDocu.IrPrimero()
		Do While !thisform.oTblDocu.EsEof()
			If thisform.oTblDocu.Leer("remunerativo") AND thisform.oTblDocu.Leer("pago")
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_comproba",thisform.oTblDocu.Leer("id_comproba"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"nombre",thisform.oTblDocu.Leer("nombre"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.f.)
				thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
			EndIf
			thisform.oTblDocu.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblDocu.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.oTblComprobantes.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblComprobantes.EsEof()
			thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.buscar(thisform.oTblComprobantes.leer("id_comproba"),.f.,"CLAVE")
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.t.)
			thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
			thisform.oTblComprobantes.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblComprobantes.IrPrimero()
		
		
		thisform.oTblIndicadores.irPrimero()
		thisform.oTblIndicadores.buscar("PDP",.f.,"CLAVE")
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.oTxtFechaDesde.value = thisform.oTblIndicadores.Leer("fechaDesde")
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.oTxtFechaHasta.value = thisform.oTblIndicadores.Leer("fechaHasta")
		thisform.oTblIndicadores.irPrimero()	
					
		
		thisform.cargarMonedas()
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE grabarmodificaciones
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		
		thisform.AddObject("oViewtabPromedioPagos"		,"Tg_ViewTabPromedioPagos")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblDocu","Tg_tabla","Cmp_docu","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblDatos_Monedas","Tg_tabla","monedas")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblIndicadores","Tg_tabla","tab_indicadores")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblComprobantes","Tg_tabla","tab_Comprobantes")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","Tg_tabla","tab_monedas")
		thisform.oTblMonedas.desfiltrar()
		thisform.oTblMonedas.filtrar("id_indicador='PDP'")
		thisform.oTblComprobantes.desfiltrar()
		thisform.oTblComprobantes.filtrar("id_indicador = 'PDP'")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblAux_Comprobantes"  , "Tg_Tabla", "Aux_tab_Comprobantes")
		thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.SetearProp ("BOT")
		thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.Revertir()
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblAux_monedas"  , "Tg_Tabla", "Aux_tab_monedas")
		thisform.oTblAux_monedas.SetearProp ("BOT")
		thisform.oTblAux_monedas.Revertir()
		
		ThisForm.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.Tg_cmbmonedas1.SetearTodos()
		ThisForm.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value ="TD"
		
		thisform.cargarTablas()
		thisform.cargarGrilla()
		
					
				
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarultimacotizacion
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE validardatos
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton1.Click
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblAux_monedas.EsEof()
			If thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("seleccionado")
				If !thisform.oTblmonedas.buscar(thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("id_moneda")+str(thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("rango")),.f.,"CLAVE")
					** no encontre id + rango, agrego registro
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"rango",thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("rango"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_indicador","PDP")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"backColor",thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("backColor"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"foreColor",thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("foreColor"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_moneda",thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("id_moneda"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"nombre",thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("nombre"))
					** 26/03
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"esPos",IIF(thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("rango")>0,"T","F"))
					** 26/03
					thisform.oTblmonedas.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
				Else
					** encontre id+rango, modifico registro
					**=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"rango",thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("rango"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_indicador","PDP")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"backColor",thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("backColor"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"foreColor",thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("foreColor"))
					thisform.oTblmonedas.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
				EndIf
			Else
				If thisform.oTblmonedas.buscar(thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("id_moneda")+str(thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("rango")),.f.,"CLAVE")
					thisform.oTblmonedas.borrar() 
				EndIf
			EndIf
			thisform.oTblAux_monedas.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblAux_monedas.IrPrimero()
		
		
		thisform.oTblAux_monedas.desfiltrar()
		thisform.oTblmonedas.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblmonedas.EsEof()
			If !thisform.oTblAux_monedas.buscar(thisform.oTblmonedas.leer("id_moneda")+str(thisform.oTblmonedas.leer("rango")),.f.,"CLAVE")
				** no encuentro id+rango (se elimino o modifico)
				thisform.oTblmonedas.borrar()
			EndIf	
			thisform.oTblmonedas.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblmonedas.IrPrimero()
		
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.EsEof()
			If thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.leer("seleccionado")
				If !thisform.oTblComprobantes.buscar(thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.leer("id_comproba"),.f.,"CLAVE")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_indicador","PDP")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_comproba",thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.leer("id_comproba"))
					thisform.oTblComprobantes.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
				EndIf
			Else
				If thisform.oTblComprobantes.buscar(thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.leer("id_comproba"),.f.,"CLAVE")
					thisform.oTblComprobantes.borrar() 
				EndIf
			EndIf
			thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblAux_Comprobantes.IrPrimero()
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.oTblIndicadores.irPrimero()
		thisform.oTblIndicadores.buscar("PDP",.f.,"CLAVE")
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"fechadesde",thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.oTxtFechaDesde.value)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"fechahasta",thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page3.oTxtFechaHasta.value)
		thisform.oTblIndicadores.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		thisform.oTblIndicadores.irPrimero()	
					
		this.Enabled = .F.
		thisform.lmodifico = .F.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton5.Click
		IF thisform.lModifico
			IF fMensPregunto("¿Desea descartar las modificaciones?","N",.F.) = "S"
				thisform.Release()
			ENDIF 
		ELSE 
			thisform.Release()
		ENDIF 
		
	ENDPROC

		thisform.lmodifico = .T.
	ENDPROC

		thisform.lmodifico = .T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page2.Tg_cmbmonedas1.InteractiveChange
		*** FILTRAR TABLA
		
		If thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.page2.tg_cmbmonedas1.value = "TD"
			thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.desfiltrar()
		Else
			thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.filtrar("id_moneda=thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.page2.tg_cmbmonedas1.value")
		EndIf	
			
		thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.fijarTag("CLAVE")
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.page2.Tg_Grid1.Refresh()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page2.Tg_commandbutton2.Click
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.IrUltimo()
		iif(thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.Page2.tg_cmbmonedas1.value="TD",.t.,thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.buscar(thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.page2.tg_cmbmonedas1.value,.f.,"CLAVE"))    
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_moneda",iif(thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.page2.tg_cmbmonedas1.value="TD","",thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.page2.tg_cmbmonedas1.value))
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"nombre",iif(thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.page2.tg_cmbmonedas1.value="TD","",thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.leer("nombre")))
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.t.)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"rango",0)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"foreColor",16777215)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"backColor",16777215)
		thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.AgregaryModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.page2.Tg_Grid1.Refresh()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page2.Tg_commandbutton4.Click
		If thisform.oTblAux_monedas.leer("rango") <> 0
			thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.borrar()
		
			If !thisform.oTblAux_monedas.buscar(thisform.oTblmonedas.leer("id_moneda")+str(thisform.oTblmonedas.leer("rango")),.f.,"CLAVE")
				thisform.oTblmonedas.borrar()
			EndIf	
				
			thisform.Tg_PageFrame1.page2.Tg_Grid1.Refresh()
		Else
			** imprimir mensaje, no se puede eliminar el rango 0
		
		EndIf
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page2.Tg_grid1.AfterRowColChange
		LPARAMETERS nColIndex
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page2.Tg_grid1.BeforeRowColChange
		LPARAMETERS nColIndex
		
	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

		thisform.lmodifico = .T.

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page2.Tg_grid1.Column4.Text1.RightClick
		this.BackColor = GetColor()
		this.foreColor = this.BackColor
		
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"backColor", this.BackColor)
		thisform.oTblAux_monedas.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page2.Tg_grid1.Refresh
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oTblAux_monedas.EsEof()
			thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.buscar(thisform.oTblAux_Monedas.leer("id_moneda"),.f.,"CLAVE")
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"nombre",thisform.oTblDatos_Monedas.leer("nombre"))
			thisform.oTblAux_monedas.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
			thisform.oTblAux_monedas.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		thisform.oTblAux_monedas.IrPrimero()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page3.oTxtFechaDesde.Click
		thisform.tg_commandbutton1.Enabled = .T.
		thisform.lmodifico = .T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page3.oTxtFechaDesde.InteractiveChange
		thisform.tg_commandbutton1.Enabled = .T.
		thisform.lmodifico = .T.
	ENDPROC

		thisform.tg_commandbutton1.Enabled = .T.
		thisform.lmodifico = .T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page3.oTxtFechaHasta.InteractiveChange
		thisform.tg_commandbutton1.Enabled = .T.
		thisform.lmodifico = .T.
	ENDPROC

DEFINE CLASS tg_configuracionrentabilidad AS tg_formdlg OF "..\lib\tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" 
 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="form" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

	*-- OBJECTDATA items order determines ZOrder / El orden de los items OBJECTDATA determina el ZOrder 
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_3dshape1" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_commandbutton3" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_grid2" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_grid2.Column1.Header1" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_grid2.Column1.Text1" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_grid2.Column3.Header1" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_grid2.Column3.Text1" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_grid2.Column3.TG_CHECKBOX1" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_grid1" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_grid1.Column1.Header1" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_grid1.Column1.Text1" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_grid1.Column3.Header1" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_grid1.Column3.Text1" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_grid1.Column3.TG_CHECKBOX1" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_grid1.Column2.Header1" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_grid1.Column2.Text1" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_commandbutton2" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_label1" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
